 Apply now
 Job no: 938765

 Work type: Full time

 Location: Various

 Categories: Administration, Business and Management





 

Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network 

Located in: Various-Negotiable

Salary: $74,095 - $78,694 per annum (adjusted to hours worked)

Full-time, Ongoing

WHAT ARE WE OFFERING? 

This role places you at the centre of patient care coordination, delivering a professional and welcoming first point of contact while supporting the smooth management of elective surgery admissions. You will manage bookings, maintain accurate records, and respond to enquiries with empathy and efficiency, ensuring patients are informed and supported throughout their pre-admission journey.

As part of a collaborative team, you will also contribute to project work, policy development, and process improvements that enhance service delivery. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact by strengthening systems, supporting colleagues, and helping deliver safe, high-quality care.

WHO ARE WE? 

The Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network offers opportunities across our sites, from Kangaroo Island to Eudunda, wrapping all the way around our metropolitan areas. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional care to all our consumers, residents, their families, and community. Our mission is to ensure that you always receive the best quality, safe, consistent, collaborative care and always with kindness. We do this by maintaining exceptional levels of care at all times supported by systems and processes that assure us of quality and safety of our staff and those we serve.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

Do you deliver a professional, friendly, and confidential first point of contact for patients and stakeholders?

Can you manage admissions, bookings, and patient data with accuracy and attention to detail? 

Are you able to communicate with empathy and clarity when supporting patients through pre-admission processes?

Do you take initiative to improve systems, support projects, and contribute to policy development?

Can you build strong working relationships and collaborate effectively across teams and services?

If you have answered yes to any of these questions - then read on. 

HOW WILL YOU CONTRIBUTE? 

You will.... 

Coordinate elective surgery admissions, including bookings, waitlists, and pre-admission processes

Provide a professional first point of contact, managing enquiries with efficiency, empathy, and confidentiality

Maintain and update patient information systems and ensure accurate documentation at all times

Support project work, policy development, and continuous improvement initiatives across the service 

Liaise with internal teams and external stakeholders to support effective service delivery and patient flow

WHAT WILL WE OFFER YOU IN RETURN? 

At BHFLHN, not only will you be working in an environment surrounded by beautiful scenery and nature we see your work here as not just as a job, but an opportunity to extend, progress or consolidate your career with us. We therefore offer you opportunities to be supported in the following ways:

Salary package a range of benefits (including living expenses such as mortgage, rent, utility bills and groceries) up to $9,010 each FBT year + $2,650 for Meal Entertainment expenses each FBT yearClick here more information

Access to generous leave provisions and professional development opportunities.

Support for you and your family via our free Employee Assistance Program.

Health and Fitness Benefits: Access to Fitness Passport, a discounted workplace health and fitness program available to BHFLHN staff and their families.

Working in this environment, it is important to us that we only employ people with the upmost integrity and commitment to serving the South Australian community and its visitors to the highest possible standards. To ensure that we meet that commitment there are a few checks that you will be required to undertake. These are detailed on the Role Description, but are likely to include the following:

You will need to be immunised. Please contact the Enquiries Person for this position if you have any queries. Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy.Further information is in the application for to help guide you. 

You will need to undergo employment screening, what you require is also on the front page of the Role Description.

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION 

We employ people as diverse as the clients we support and the environments we work in. At BHFLHN we pride ourselves on being an Equal Opportunity employer committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees and therefore we encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, disability, all genders, and LGBTQI+ community. We continually look for ways to support and promote diversity and flexible ways of working so please let us know what interests you.

## Sales and Marketing Manager
## Position Overview
We are looking for a dynamic and results-driven Sales and Marketing Manager to lead and execute strategic commercial initiatives across our organisation. This role is central to driving revenue growth, brand positioning, and market expansion through the effective management of both sales operations and marketing programmes. The ideal candidate is a confident leader with a proven track record of delivering measurable outcomes in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment. You will bring a strategic mindset, strong analytical capability, and the ability to inspire and manage cross-functional teams.
## Key Responsibilities
- Formulate, implement, and continuously refine integrated sales and marketing strategies, ensuring alignment with broader organisational goals and growth targets
- Develop and oversee advertising, public relations, and promotional campaigns, working collaboratively with internal stakeholders and external agencies to maximise brand impact
- Establish and manage sales territories, customer service standards, and product mix to optimise market coverage and revenue performance
- Direct and coordinate the activities of sales personnel, agents, and distributors to ensure consistent execution of sales methods and commercial objectives
- Set pricing structures, credit arrangements, and discount frameworks in line with market conditions and company profitability targets
- Oversee merchandising methods and distribution policy, ensuring product availability and visibility across all relevant channels
- Monitor and analyse market trends, competitor activity, and customer insights to inform strategic decision-making and identify new business opportunities
- Develop and manage the sales and marketing budget, tracking expenditure and return on investment to ensure efficient allocation of resources
- Lead the generation and nurturing of leads across digital and traditional channels, converting pipeline opportunities into long-term client relationships
- Produce regular performance reports and present findings to senior leadership, providing data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement
- Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, partners, and industry stakeholders to support retention and business development
- Recruit, mentor, and develop team members, fostering a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and professional growth
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline
- Minimum of 5 years' experience in a sales and/or marketing management role, with demonstrated success in meeting or exceeding commercial targets
- Strong understanding of both B2B and B2C sales environments, including pipeline management and customer lifecycle strategies
- Proven experience developing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns, including digital, content, and traditional media
- Proficiency in CRM platforms and marketing automation tools, with the ability to leverage data for strategic insight
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to present to senior stakeholders and external partners
- Demonstrated leadership capability, with experience managing, coaching, and developing sales and marketing teams
- High level of commercial acumen and a customer-centric approach to business development
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results within deadlines
## Preferred Qualifications
- Postgraduate qualification such as a Master of Business Administration (MBA) or equivalent
- Professional accreditation with the Australian Marketing Institute (AMI) or a recognised industry body
- Experience working within a specific industry relevant to our business, such as retail, technology, professional services, or FMCG
- Familiarity with SEO, SEM, and performance marketing strategies, as well as experience managing digital advertising budgets
- Exposure to international or cross-regional markets, including an understanding of export or distribution networks
- Experience with sales enablement tools, marketing analytics platforms, or enterprise-level CRM systems such as Salesforce or HubSpot
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking organisation that genuinely values innovation, initiative, and professional development
- Access ongoing learning and career progression opportunities, including support for further study, industry certifications, and leadership programmes
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with hybrid arrangements available, supporting a healthy work-life balance
- Benefit from a competitive remuneration package, including performance-based incentives that reward your contribution to the business
- Join a team culture built on trust, inclusivity, and shared purpose, where your ideas are heard and your impact is recognised
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
